reviews.name: Putera Nor Danish
reviews.text:
found this clinic on Google while looking for my regular dentist, but honestly… quite disappointing.

Before coming, I already texted to confirm scaling price. The admin mentioned RM100–RM200, which I was totally okay with. But when I arrived, suddenly there was an additional dental check-up fee that was never informed earlier.

Look — I’m not against paying. But tell upfront. That’s basic customer service.

Then comes the shocking part…
At payment, my bill was RM200+ just for scaling. I asked politely what caused the price to go that high, but the receptionist kept repeating, “harga scaling lah” without proper explanation.

No breakdown, no effort to clarify — just vibes.

Also, service-wise… quite disappointing. Sitting there, no initiative to explain properly, no warmth. A bit kampung attitude, honestly. If you’re handling customers, at least show professionalism — stand, explain, and communicate clearly.

I’ve been to many dental clinics before, never had this kind of experience.

Conclusion:

* ❌ Not transparent with pricing
* ❌ Poor communication
* ❌ Customer service needs improvement

Safe to say… won’t be coming back.

我本人很怕针，医生很专业跟我解说，手法非常温柔而且很细心，一个步骤一个步骤的把我那颗“大牙” 嘴里后面第二颗牙齿完全的无痛的拔出来了 ！真的一点痛感都没有 ！非常专业 ！ 医术高明 ！

我很开心 We Smile Dental 解决了我牙齿的痛苦。多几个月我会过来做假牙。专业 + 亲切而且收费合理。非常推介

reviews.text:
I visited this clinic about a year ago, and the service was excellent. The staff were friendly, professional, and the dentist provided great care, which is why I decided to return.

Unfortunately, my recent experience was disappointing. I initially requested to delay my appointment by about 30 minutes. The staff explained that they were concerned it would affect the schedule and potentially delay the next patient's appointment. I understood their concern and respected their policy. Although they later offered to reschedule my appointment to the next day, I chose to make every effort to keep the original appointment and arranged my schedule accordingly.

However, about 20 minutes before my appointment, while I was already on my way after taking time off work, I was informed that my appointment needed to be rescheduled due to an emergency.

I completely understand that emergencies can happen and are sometimes unavoidable. However, it was frustrating because I had gone out of my way to accommodate the clinic's schedule after being told that a delay on my side could impact the appointments of other patients. In the end, my appointment was cancelled while I was already travelling to the clinic.

I still appreciate the quality of care I received during my previous visit, but I hope the clinic can improve its communication and appointment management in situations like this to minimise inconvenience for patients
